notes: ACCESS: Tier (a) direct HTTP fetch (requests, browser UA) was blocked on the homepage by a PerimeterX human-challenge/CAPTCHA wall (HTTP 403, 'px-captcha' page). Tier (b) Playwright/Chromium headless was also blocked by the same PerimeterX challenge (title 'Access to this page has been denied'). Escalated to tier (c) Claude-in-Chrome (real logged-in Chrome tab) which loaded the site normally with no block. robots.txt (fetched via tier a before any block) has no anthropic-ai/ClaudeBot/Claude-Web/Claude-User/Claude-SearchBot entry and only disallows /*collection.do*, /*product.do*, /?method*, /*print.do*, /modal/, /sitesearch/ etc (SEO-facet/PDP/search paths) - none of the category-listing paths used here are disallowed, so tier (c) browsing was permitted. TREE: built via union of the mega-menu (Living, Dining & Kitchen, Bedroom, Bath, Storage & Entryway, Office, Lighting, Rugs, Home Decor, Outdoor, Made for You) read from the rendered DOM (read_page 'all' captured every flyout's hrefs even when collapsed) plus each category root page's own sub-nav (get_page_text on /catalog/<section>). No XML sitemap was used since the mega-menu + sub-nav gave full coverage and sitemap.xml is very large/product-level. QTY: site is Next.js SSR and renders the full, unpaginated product list in the initial HTML for every listing page (no 'N items' counter text and no Load More/pagination control found) - qty was taken as the exact count of 'Save to Favorites' buttons in document.body.innerText via javascript_tool, one button per product card, verified against the visible product list on several pages (e.g. Bedroom Rugs = 47 matched exactly). h1 and canonical link were checked on every leaf to confirm the page matches the requested node. EXCLUDED - facet duplication avoided: Rugs has three parallel nav facets (Rugs by Style: All/Solid/Patterned/Rug Pads, Rugs by Room: 7 rooms, Rugs by Size: 7 sizes) all drawing from the same ~50-SKU rug catalog; only 'Rugs by Room' was recorded as the canonical hierarchy (matches the room-based pattern used everywhere else on the site), 'by Style' and 'by Size' were skipped as cross-cutting facets of the same inventory, not genuine distinct subcategories. Storage & Entryway's /entryway-rugs page (same content as /catalog/rugs/entryway-rugs under a second URL) was skipped in favor of the Rugs-section URL. Similarly Throw Pillows has Patterned Pillows + Solid Pillows (genuine mutually-exclusive style split, both included) plus 'Pillows by Color' (cross-cutting color facet of the same SKUs) and 'Pillow Pairings' / Outdoor 'Outdoor Pillow Pairings' (curated marketing 'shop the look' pairing pages reusing the same individual pillow SKUs, not a real subcategory) - both skipped as facet/collection duplicates. Office's /catalog/office/coat-racks (fav=16, self-canonical) mirrors the same 16 products as /catalog/storage-and-entryway/coat-racks; only the Storage & Entryway URL was kept. EXCLUDED - decorative boundary: Home Decor 'Shelves & Ledges' (title 'Modern Wall Shelves & Ledges') = Float Wall Shelves/Trace Picture Ledges/Foshay Wall Shelves, purely decorative floating wall shelves -> Wall Decor domain, not Storage. Home Decor 'Trays & Small Storage' (29 items) and Office 'Desktop Organizers' (19 items) were inspected product-by-product and found overwhelmingly decorative serving/desk trays, monitor risers and leather desk accessories (Kitchen & Dining / Decorative Home Accessories domain) with only 1-2 incidental storage items each (a shoe/magazine rack, a cork storage box) - excluded wholesale per storage.md Section 8/26 (decorative tray boundary). Dining & Kitchen 'Tabletop' (49 items: trays, bowls) and 'Care & Cleaning' (3 items: wood cleaner, hand wash, oil) are Kitchen & Dining/cleaning products, not Textile or Storage - excluded. Bath 'Bath Storage' (8 items: Linen Cabinets, Medicine Cabinet Sets) is bathroom cabinet furniture, already Furniture-domain - excluded. INCLUDED with LOW/MEDIUM confidence (flagged, review queue): Bath 'Bath Organization' (42 items) is a single listing mixing genuine storage (baskets, canisters, storage boxes, ladders, shower caddies) with decorative bath accessories (trays, tissue box covers, candle holder, tumbler) under one URL that cannot be split - included as Storage LOW confidence since the category is explicitly named 'Organization' and storage items form roughly half the list. Bath 'Hooks, Shelves & Ledges' (37 items) and Home Decor 'Hooks & Wall Organizers' (28 items) similarly mix genuine wall hooks/coat racks (majority, storage-functional) with a minority of decorative wall shelves (also cross-listed under the site's own 'Wall Decor' megamenu section) - included as Storage MEDIUM confidence, flagged. Bedroom 'Bedding Essentials' (10: pillows, pillow protectors, duvet inserts, mattress toppers/pad) and 'Bedding Bundles' (10: multi-item bedding bundle SKUs) are genuine textile bedding product lines (not promotional landing pages, each is an individually priced, purchasable product) - included as Textile. Outdoor 'Outdoor Cushions' (seat/chair cushions) and 'Outdoor Pillows' (decorative throw pillows) are two distinct genuine outdoor textile product types and both included separately.
